in_arabic.name: Farradah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Farradah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic verb ‘farada’ which means to continue or to carry on, Farradah is a name that symbolizes the idea of perseverance and continuity. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name carries spiritual significance as a reminder to carry on with good deeds and to persist in one's faith.
